# Flippy Bit — Implementation Plan 
//Implementation Plan Generated by AI

Target grade: **High HD (90+)** — full game requirements + advanced
feature(s), all in strict FRP style.

Due: **4 Sep 2026, 11:55 PM**. Week 5 check-in: 29 Aug.

---

## Architecture (Asteroids pattern)

| Module               | Responsibility                                                     |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `src/constants.ts`   | Tuning values (sizes, rates, speeds) — no logic                    |
| `src/types.ts`       | `Bit`, `DigitBank`, `FallingTargetView`, `Action`, `State`         |
| `src/state.ts`       | `initialState`, pure helpers, `Action` classes, `reduceState`      |
| `src/observable.ts`  | One `Observable<Action>` per input source                          |
| `src/view.ts`        | The only DOM-touching module; `render` reconciles SVG              |
| `src/main.ts`        | `merge` all action streams → `scan(reduceState)` → one `subscribe` |
| `tests/main.test.ts` | Vitest specs over the pure state layer                             |

Data flow: `merge(tick$, flipDigit$, spawn$, …).pipe(scan(reduceState, initialState)).subscribe(render())`

State lives only in the `scan` accumulator — never in the DOM or in
mutable variables.

## Commit discipline (spec requirement)

Every commit message must contain the **date + time**, the **files
changed**, and **why**. Commit every logical unit (~30–60 min).

```
2026-08-28 21:40 — src/state.ts, src/types.ts: add Tick/FlipDigit
actions and DigitBank helpers so the scan loop has a pure model to fold
```

## FRP rules (do not break — they gate a passing grade)

- `scan` + `merge` manage all state
- No `for` / `while` / `let` / `var`; no mutation of non-`readonly` data
- Side effects only inside the single `subscribe` (rendering)
- No `any`; prefer generic, reusable pure functions
